title: SG-7.7 · Worker startup recovery for unfinished executions and stale locks
summary: On startup the worker scans its execution store, resumes or marks unfinished executions, and releases stale locks, covered by unit tests with a mocked store and clock.
description: Context: backend/worker/internal has config, lock, logging, report, runner and store packages but no recovery. store.Store persists executions as JSON; runner.Run takes a lock file via lock.Acquire, which leaves the file behind if the process dies. Desired behavior: a new recovery package scans for unfinished executions (PENDING, RUNNING, RECOVERING) and resumes each, or marks it RECOVERING when resuming fails, and removes a stale lock file. Expected result: the worker can start after a crash without manual cleanup. Why: the product requires recovery after process restart and never assuming the worker ran continuously.
acceptance_criteria: Given PENDING, RUNNING and RECOVERING executions in the store, When Recover runs, Then each is passed to the Resumer exactly once
Given COMPLETED, FAILED or AWAITING_APPROVAL executions, When Recover runs, Then they are neither resumed nor modified

Given the Resumer returns an error for an execution, When Recover runs, Then that execution is saved as RECOVERING with the error text, UpdatedAt set from the injected clock, and the remaining executions are still processed
Given a lock file older than StaleAfter by the injected clock, When startup recovery runs, Then the lock file is removed before executions are resumed
Given a lock file younger than StaleAfter or no lock file, When startup recovery runs, Then no lock is removed and no error is returned

in_scope: New RECOVERING status constant in backend/worker/internal/store/store.go
out_of_scope: Wiring into a worker main or cmd entry point (none exists)
Changing runner.Run, lock.Acquire or the config file schema
preserve: store.Store JSON format and atomic Save

technical_constraints: All dependencies injected for unit tests: store, resumer, clock, lock filesystem
definition_of_done: All acceptance criteria are met by product code
non_functional: Recovery must not hold the lock file while resuming, since runner.Run acquires it
